page.overview:
Who is Mozgus?

Mozgus is the most feared and famous Holy See inquisitor. He travels with his group of personal torturers to the city of Albion. His symbol is four . He is the main antagonist of the Conviction Arc, hindering Guts' efforts in saving Casca with his excessive religious zeal.

An ardent follower of "God", Mozgus is an extremely devout man whose faith ventures into fanaticism. He greatly emphasizes his religion in everything he does. He travels with his torturers, whom he cares for. Mozgus is in great distress after learning of their deaths.

Mozgus heavily dislikes "heretics". He tried and questioned hundreds using brutal and intense methods of interrogation. To him, a single mole could pass as the mark of a witch or heretic. This made him the target of lots of spite and malice. Mozgus is highly sensitive toward anyone who would "claim" God's will, killing a villager for saying Mozgus would be punished by God for his arbitrary acts.

Despite knowing he appears sadistic and bloodthirsty, Mozgus is aware of the sadness that enforcing God's strict laws entails, as it brings pain to others. Still, he feels no guilt for his actions. In his mind, spilling blood leads to exist devoutly for God. This was especially shown during his parable of the holy woman and the dying man, where he teaches Farnese that a person knows not what succeeds in helping.
